author: Kevin Stratvert
description:
Most teams today use too many tools — documents in one place, tasks in another, and meetings everywhere. And somehow, things still fall through the cracks.

So what does a modern team workflow actually look like with AI built in?

In this video, I walk through a full project from start to finish using Atlassian’s Teamwork Collection — including Jira, Confluence, Loom, and Rovo AI. You’ll see how a team can:
- Set clear goals and track progress
- Generate project plans with AI
- Replace meetings with async video updates
- Turn ideas into structured work instantly
- Keep everything connected across tools

Instead of jumping between apps, everything works together in one connected system — with AI helping at every step.

To make this real, I use a complete example: launching a mobile app for the Kevin Cookie Company.

By the end, you’ll see exactly how modern teams work faster, stay aligned, and get more done with AI.

👉 Get started here: https://teamworkcollection.kevinstratvert.com
